changelog: **VPAT 2.1.4 and 3.2.6 close (#2864):** the shortcut sheet gets a "Single-key shortcuts" switch that turns the `?` binding off (per browser, `shortcuts.singleKey` in localStorage, read through `readSingleKeyShortcutsEnabled()` in `src/lib/shortcuts.ts`); the sheet stays reachable from the command palette. 3.2.6 is evidenced by `e2e/consistent-help.spec.ts`, which asserts the "Report a problem" button keeps one position across the admin, mentor and mentee shells. Both rows now read `Supports`; `npm run vpat:evidence` regenerated.

en: You can now turn off the single-key "?" shortcut from the keyboard shortcut list — handy with speech input.
tr: Tek tuşlu "?" kısayolunu artık klavye kısayolları listesinden kapatabilirsiniz — sesle yazarken işe yarar.
de: Das Einzeltasten-Kürzel „?“ lässt sich jetzt in der Liste der Tastenkürzel ausschalten — praktisch bei Spracheingabe.
